learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to collect information, make smart lists, and read charts to plan a super fun party!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: To plan a party, we need to ask our friends what they like to eat. We can write this down to see how many kids want cake and how many want samosas!
Instead of a messy list, we can draw a table with smiley faces. One smiley means one friend. This helps us read our data quickly!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Family Feast Chart
fun_activity.instructions: Ask everyone in your family if they prefer ice cream or juice. Make a beautiful chart using tally marks or little drawings to show the winner!

quick_recap: ⭐ Collecting data means asking questions and recording the answers.
⭐ Charts and tables make our information neat and easy to understand.
